findings.trigger: A nonempty field in the REG-04 proof-of-possession challenge
findings.ambiguity: The global len16(s) includes s, whereas REG-04 appends s separately and redefines len16 as length only.
findings.consequence: Conforming readers can derive different signed challenge bytes and disagree on key registration or resolution.
findings.correction: Define len16 once as length only, align REG-04, and add exact challenge-byte vectors.

findings.trigger: Registration and selection of the required X25519 HPKE key
findings.ambiguity: REG-01 requires a chapter-11 alg value and rejects unknown values, but chapter 11 registers only signing alg literals; X25519 is a key type without a specified registry alg literal.
findings.consequence: A strict implementation cannot register or select the responder KEM key consistently.
findings.correction: Define an exact X25519 registry alg literal and validation rule, exclude it from signature use, and add registration and handshake vectors.

next_gate: Resolve both normative findings in a separately pinned revision, then independently re-review and run version-bound implementation and Inspector checks before any conformance claim.
